release_notes: Streams, done the Keitaro way - plus tables that configure themselves. Stream landings/offers are picked through a full selector modal now: the Add split button opens instant search by name/URL/id with group, affiliate-network and country filters, multi-select with Select all, already-added badges, and even weight redistribution across the stream on Add; the dropdown's second action creates a new landing/offer without leaving the stream. Stream filters can combine with AND or OR - per stream, with abstaining filters (unknown country/ISP) blocking nothing, saved with the campaign and carried by copy/export. The Landings and Offers tables gain 'Select and Order Columns': checkboxes, Select All, drag-to-reorder, localStorage persistence and Restore to default; the offers table's new columns (leads, sales, rejected, conversions-as-events, CR, EPC/CPC confirmed, revenue/cost/P&L/ROI confirmed) are computed by the very engine behind the verified 64-metric reports and pinned by a reference-dataset test. The campaign column customizer's checkboxes, Select All and drag reorder work again (draggable rows used to swallow every click). The affiliate-network postback URL builds the full template with macros - editable, and copyable in one click; already-added networks show their saved URL in the list. Offer and Landing editors are unified (Create titles, General|Parameters|Notes tabs, one type switcher, matching footers). Fixed: campaign groups were saved into offer_groups and never showed in the filter; active toggle text disappeared on light-accent themes like Neon; empty ghost rows in streams became honest placeholders with an empty state; Asia/Kolkata (IST, UTC+5:30) is selectable in every timezone dropdown. Local landings open on the very first click after a ZIP upload: nested-folder archives flatten automatically (Finder's __MACOSX junk removed), legacy nested uploads resolve at serve time with their assets, and the editor blocks Save until the archive lands.
